results.title: Gigalow
results.overview: Left with debt and tasked with raising his sister, a young man climbs the underground dance scene only to find success comes at a high cost.

results.title: Evil Eye
results.overview: Driven by childhood traumas of neglect and severe body image issues, a prominent beauty influencer's obsessive pursuit of online validation triggers a devastating spiritual curse, resulting in a gruesome physical deterioration that challenges her vanity.

results.title: The Strawberry
results.overview: After a terminal diagnosis, Herb Kaplan seeks peace with his broken family and the joy he long overlooked. As old wounds heal and new bonds form, he learns to cherish the sweetness in front of him and say goodbye on his own terms.

results.title: 200 Lives, Paco Rabal
results.overview: Through cassette recordings of his voice and the super8 films of his travels, film shoots and festivals he would attend despite his political engagement as a screen idol of the Franco era, Paco Rabal (Best Actor Award at the first Festival in 1953 and Donostia Award in 2001) looks back at his life, regrets and contradictions. An impressive list of films recalling the time of his death in Bordeaux, like Goya, the man he played several times. In San Sebastián, he enjoyed success alongside Rafael Gil, Lucas Demare, León Klimovsky, Pedro Olea and Jaime de Armiñán.

results.title: Madonnas
results.overview: Nancy inherits a vintage caravan, and with her friend, Georgina, they embark on a road trip. They come up with the crazy idea of turning it into a brothel for women. The search for dick ends when they find a traveler, and together they launch “Madonna.” They resist conservatism with humor, love and solidarity. “Madonna, you pussies!”

results.title: All the Good Eyes
results.overview: The story chronicles four decades in the lives of a family deeply rooted in the soil of Northeast China. Through times of prosperity and hardship, they navigate cycles of love and hatred, fortune and misfortune. Though buffeted by the twists of fate, they never relinquish their steadfast guardianship of one another and the profound commitment to this ancestral land that sustains them.

results.title: Bucking Fastard
results.overview: Two sisters, Jean and Joan Holbrooke, are so close to each other that they speak in unison, love the same man, and have the same dreams. They even make the same slip of tongue in unison. We cannot see the world as they see it, but we do see how the world reacts to them – through the courts and the press, through those that want to help and those who want to use them, through the eyes of beasts both tame and wild, and even through their own echoes in the core of the earth.

results.title: Razor
results.overview: When a little girl is hunted to be killed by a powerful politician and his ruthless criminal network, an unassuming dog groomer becomes her guardian angel as her fate dangles between survival and certain death.

results.title: Red Riding
results.overview: After her mother's overdose, teen Red Riding moves from London to her estranged grandmother's Scottish estate, where dark family secrets, missing children, and a monstrous wolf blur reality, forcing her to fight for survival.

results.title: Thudakkam
results.overview: When danger strikes, a young woman fights to survive through courage and determination.

results.title: A Child of My Own
results.overview: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

results.title: The Righteous
results.overview: Nine members of a jury are sequestered while deliberating a controversial corruption case. The evidence is overwhelming, public opinion has already reached its verdict, and no one seems to have any doubts… Until they receive a secret offer: each juror will earn one million euros if they change their vote from guilty to not guilty. But to take the deal, they must reach a unanimous decision. The challenge will expose the hidden motives of every member of the jury. A gripping and thoughtful thriller that will keep you on the edge of your seat!

results.title: Lorne
results.overview: An unprecedented, behind-the-scenes glimpse at the man who built the inimitable empire of comedy, shaping television and culture for generations. The documentary features exclusive footage, archival treasures, and candid interviews with the show’s most iconic cast members and writers including Tina Fey, Maya Rudolph, John Mulaney, Andy Samberg, Conan O’Brien, Chris Rock and many more.

results.title: Ghost School
results.overview: Ten-year-old Rabia wants to know why her school has suddenly closed. Rumours are rife in the village and the authorities are no help. Courageously setting out to find the truth, Rabia navigates rural superstitions, local corruption and a wall of silence.

results.title: Virginia Woolf's Night & Day
results.overview: In 1910 London, an independent-minded young woman challenges her family’s expectations of marriage to pursue astronomy, questioning the restrictions of society, love, and tradition as she searches for a life of her own.

results.title: Storm Rider: Legend of Hammerhead
results.overview: Centuries after the Great Flood, riders compete in death races on the water to secure shelter for their people behind the walls of Argos. Rebellious storm riders Neb and Ana look to uncover hidden truths by breaking through the storm.

results.title: Last Stream
results.overview: Desperate for views, a fading streamer stages a fake haunting connected to an unsolved case. The stream spirals into a real-time nightmare watched by tens of thousands and someone in the chat seems to know exactly how the night will end.

results.title: Sadali
results.overview: Three years after his love story ended, Sadali chooses a quiet life as a painter in Magelang and prepares for the most important exhibition of his career. His tranquility is disturbed when he hears the news of Mera's marriage and reunites with Mera and Arnaza, two figures from his past who have left scars. Trapped between regret, suppressed love, and a search for identity, Sadali must choose between being tied to the past or moving towards new meanings in love and art.

results.title: Vibeland Chronicles
results.overview: As the events of a modern day Zodiac killer unfold, different stories, characters, and music intertwine within a surreal San Francisco, also known as Vibeland. From underground criminal labyrinths to violent job application simulations to haunted buses after midnight to dancing serial killers, nothing that happens in Vibeland is ordinary.
